header.title: How to Install a Refrigerator Compressor
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to replace a refrigerator compressor, covering removal of the old unit and installation of the new one.

steps.description: Remove all items from the refrigerator and store them in coolers with ice packs to preserve them during the appliance's power-off period.
actions: Clean out the fridge
Take everything out of the fridge
Put items into coolers
Use ice packs

steps.description: Pull the refrigerator away from the wall to access the back for compressor work.
actions: Pull the fridge out
Get help if needed
Pull the fridge away from the wall
Ensure sufficient space for access and work

steps.description: Remove the guard plate located behind the refrigerator to access the internal mechanism.
actions: Remove the guard plate
Set the guard plate to the side
Wait about 20 minutes for the machinery to cool off

steps.description: This step instructs the user to locate and carefully remove the compressor from the refrigerator.
actions: Find the compressor.
Remove the cover plate (if present).
Use a socket wrench to remove the nuts securing the cover plate.
Stop and assess the connections before removing the compressor.

steps.description: Photograph the existing compressor and its wiring connections before disassembly to use as a visual reference during reinstallation.
actions: Take several pictures of your compressor as it sits.
Take photos of all the connections where the wires meet the compressor.
Work slowly and detach these wires one at a time.
Stop to take pictures after every wire you remove.
Squeeze clips to pull wires off the compressor (if applicable).
Remove wires with wire cutters (if applicable).
Set the old compressor off to the side.

steps.description: Reattach the wires to the new compressor, using photos as a reference if needed.
actions: Attach the wires
Set the new compressor into position
Hold it in place
Carefully re-attach the wires
Use photos as a reference if needed

steps.description: Add refrigerant to the refrigerator, following instructions provided with the refrigerant and the refrigerator's manufacturer information.
actions: Add the refrigerant.
Refer to the refrigerant instructions.

Determine the correct type of refrigerant needed.

Plug the fridge back in
Listen for the hum of the compressor
Open the fridge
Check if the fridge is getting cooler
